metadata.case_name: HARVEY KENNETH v. WELLTEX INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENTAL LTD. AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: compound fracture of the right zygoma and maxilla; severe fracture of the facial bones on the right side
source: it was discovered that he had suffered a compound fracture of the right zygoma and maxilla.
He had a severe fracture of the facial bones on the right side requiring extensive surgery and reconstruction and further surgery for removal of the plate a year later.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple fractures involving skull or facial bones

injuries.description: fracture of the posterior column of his right acetabulum
source: suffer a fracture of the posterior column of his right acetabulum
The fracture of his pelvis has united well without displacement and both Dr Lau Hoi Kuen and Dr Arthur Chiang report a full range of movement in the right hip with no abnormality seen on x-ray.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of acetabulum without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: deep laceration and a number of other lacerations and abrasions
source: He did, however, without losing consciousness, suffer a fracture of the posterior column of his right acetabulum, extensive damage to the bones of his face, together with a deep laceration, and a number of other lacerations and abrasions.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of acetabulum without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: scarring: scarring on the face and a long noticeable surgical scar over the top of his head just behind the hairline; scar on his chest over the donor site for the bone graft
source: He now has some scarring on the face and a long noticeable surgical scar over the top of his head just behind the hairline. There is also a scar on his chest over the donor site for the bone graft.

manifestations.description: pain in his hip after prolonged walking or sitting
diplopia, double vision, in the right eye on upward extreme gaze
residual pain in the right side of his face with altered sensation and some mandibular dysfunction
post traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and depression with low mood, sleep disturbance, social withdrawal, anxiety, flashbacks and avoidance of situations which reminded him of the accident
fear of returning to the sort of work he did before; reluctance to work in similar conditions

treatments_received: skin traction and bed rest for pelvic fracture
open reduction and reconstruction of facial bones using bone grafts from the ribs and titanium plates (operation on 7 November 1997)
removal of fixation plate (operation in October 1998)
attendance at psychiatric clinic since February 1999
treatments_future: psychiatric treatment (private sector; median figure quoted by experts allowed)

losses.description: Pain suffering and loss of amenities
post traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and depression with low mood, sleep disturbance, social withdrawal, anxiety, flashbacks and avoidance of situations which reminded him of the accident
